value.rationale: The isotropic constant is a standard and meaningful affine-invariant quantitative shape descriptor of nonsmooth zonoids. This theorem completely solves its two-disc dependence on radius ratio for all nonparallel plane angles, including sharp unique balance and stability and an unattained degenerating-summand supremum. The object/invariant are canonical within convex and asymptotic geometric analysis; the exact values and independence are not merely an arbitrary numerical slice.
